Subject: Re: Request: One-off purge of tenant 'acme-eu-prod' prompt/output/logs (GDPR/contract)

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask. We can run a one-off purge; below is the proposed workflow and evidence package. Please confirm acceptance of the timeline and SLAs so we can schedule the operation.

Proposed purge workflow (high-level):
1) Intake & ticketing: we create RINF-4521 and a short runbook describing the scope (tenant id, date range, exclusions).
2) Pre-run snapshot: create read-only snapshots of all affected stores (KV indices, L0 logs, request-trace archive) and capture hashes. Screenshots and S3 URIs will be included.
3) Quiesce writes: briefly pause writes to the tenant (30–60s) and drain active in-flight requests to avoid race conditions.
4) Invalidate caches: clear prefix/KV caches and evict relevant entries from the serving layer.
5) Execute deletion: run canonical delete job that removes prompt/output artifacts, index entries, and request traces.
6) Post-run verification: run verification queries to confirm zero results; capture logs and run manifest builder to produce CSV with deleted paths + SHA256 checksums.
7) Evidence delivery: provide purge_manifest_20260411.csv, pre/post snapshots, operation runbook, and an email confirmation signed by Redwood.

Timeline suggestion: schedule today (EOD UTC) for pre-snapshot and run tonight (off-hours CET) so we cause minimal customer impact. We expect evidence delivery within 4 hours of run completion.

Security signoff: Mina — please confirm any mandatory additional steps (WORM retention windows, HSM key zeroization proofs) we must include for EU-regulated customers.

If this process looks good to you, Oliver, I will ask Dev to prepare the runbook and schedule the job.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Security & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme-eu.com>

Subject: Re: Request: One-off purge of tenant 'acme-eu-prod' prompt/output/logs (GDPR/contract)

Laura / Oliver —

I prepared the runbook and test checklist. Key operational notes below (technical run steps):

Runbook excerpt (operational steps) — do not forward:
- Pre-checks: ensure no active long-running streaming sessions for tenant acme-eu-prod (api.sessions.list --tenant acme-eu-prod).
- Snapshot: cp -r s3://redwood-prod/tenants/acme-eu-prod/logs/ s3://redwood-prod/snapshots/2026-04-11-acme-eu-prod-pre/; record object hashes and a manifest.
- Pause writes: set tenant flag disable_writes=true via control-plane API (control.redwood/v1/tenants/acme-eu-prod/flags). Wait 45s.
- Cache eviction: POST internal cache/evict with filter tenant=acme-eu-prod; confirm 0 matching keys after eviction.
- Delete jobs: kick off purge-job with parameters: tenant=acme-eu-prod; dry_run=false; range=all; confirm job id RINF-PURGE-9823.
- Post-verify: run quick scans (search index, KV lookups) to ensure items return 0.

Evidence artifacts we will provide:
- purge_manifest_20260411.csv (deleted object path, size, SHA256, delete_timestamp)
- kv_index_snapshot_before.png (screenshot of key counts before run)
- delete_job_log_RINF-PURGE-9823.txt (full run log)

I will attach the manifest and the pre-run snapshot hashes after the snapshot completes. ETA for starting snapshot: 12:00 UTC. Snapshot + run should finish by 14:30 UTC today.

Notes on retention & encrypted backups: backups created before deletion will still exist in our glacier-tier backups per our retention policy. For contract-required complete eradication from backups (rare), we will need to open an extended process and confirm timelines — Mina can advise.

—Dev
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
